story.text: Next the Spirit shows him {BELLE}, years later, a happy {MOTHER} by her own fire, with her {CHILDREN} in a joyful {UPROAR}. Their {FATHER} comes home laden with Christmas toys, and the children storm him. He tells Belle he passed an old friend of hers tonight, Mr. Scrooge, sitting at his office {WINDOW}: “Quite {ALONE} in the world, I do believe.” “Spirit!” says Scrooge. “Remove me from this place.”
story.caption: Laden with Christmas toys and presents
